description: POQ_QUESTIONS_B constitutes the supplier qualification question library. The table stores all the questions created by a buying organization. Each row in this table corresponds to one revision of a question, and carries information such as question name, type of a question, type of a responder, critical question flag.

columns.name: QUESTION_ID
columns.comment: Internal system identifier for this question.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_QUESTION_ID
columns.comment: QUESTION_ID value for the revision 0 of this question.

columns.name: REVISION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Revision number of this question. Revision 0 is the base revision.

columns.name: QUESTION_NAME
columns.comment: Question name or identifier entered by the user.

columns.name: QUESTION_LEVEL
columns.comment: Indicates whether the question is relevant to a supplier or to a supplier site. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_QUESTION_LEVEL.

columns.name: RESPONDER_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates whether the question responder should be a supplier or an internal user. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_RESPONDER_TYPE.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ATTRIBUTE_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates whether the question is mapped to an attribute from the supplier profile.

columns.name: QUESTION_TYPE
columns.comment: Specifies which of the following types of question: 1) a multiple choice question with single selection, 2) a multiple choice question with multiple selections, or 3) a question without predefined acceptable responses (an input box question). The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_QUESTION_TYPE.

columns.name: QUESTION_STATUS
columns.comment: The status of the question. Values are: DRAFT, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, ARCHIVED, ARCHIVED_INACTIVE.

columns.name: MAPPED_TO_PREREQ_QUESTION_FLAG
columns.comment: If this is a checklist type of question, this flag indicates whether this question is mapped to a prerequisite question.

columns.name: MAPPED_TO_PREREQ_QUESTION_ID
columns.comment: If this is a checklist type of question mapped to a prerequisite question as denoted in MAPPED_TO_PREREQ_QUESTION_FLAG, this column identifies the prerequisite question id.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.comment: The person id of the worker who is the owner of this question.

columns.name: DISPLAY_PREFERRED_RESP_FLAG
columns.comment: Specifies whether to display the preferred response, if it exists, to the supplier.

columns.name: LATEST_REVISION_FLAG
columns.comment: Specifies whether this revision is the latest revision for this question.

columns.name: CRITICAL_QUESTION_FLAG
columns.comment: Specifies whether a question is critical for evaluation.

columns.name: RESPONSE_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.comment: Specifies whether a response is required when a responder submits the question on a questionnaire.

columns.name: ALLOW_RESP_COMMENT_FLAG
columns.comment: Specifies whether a responder can enter free text comments when submitting a response to the question on a questionnaire.

columns.name: SUBJECT_CODE
columns.comment: A code identifying a subject to be associated with the question for search purposes. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_SUBJECT.

columns.name: STDS_ORG_CODE
columns.comment: A code identifying the standards organization designated as the source of this requirement. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_STDS_ORG.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.comment: If this question is mapped to a supplier attribute, this code identifies the supplier attribute that this question is mapped. The system validates against the POQ_SUPPLIER_ATTRIBUTES_B.

columns.name: RESPONSE_TYPE
columns.comment: For a question type value of input box, the response type specifies the data type of the response. The domain values include: single line text, multiple line text, number, date, date and time, and URL. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_RESPONSE_TYPE.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_CODE
columns.comment: For a question type value of input box, this code specifies whether the responder is able to attach any documents with their response when submitting the questionnaire. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_QUESTION_RESPONSE_ATTACH.

columns.name: PREFERRED_RESPONSE_DATE
columns.comment: For a question with question type of input box and response type of date, this captures the preferred response value for this question.

columns.name: PREFERRED_RESPONSE_DATETIME
columns.comment: For a question with question type of input box and response type of date and time, this captures the preferred response value for this question.

columns.name: PREFERRED_RESPONSE_NUMBER
columns.comment: For a question with question type of input box and response type of number, this captures the preferred response value for this question.

columns.name: SCORING_METHOD
columns.comment: Code identifying the scoring method to be used for this question. The default value is NONE. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_QUESTION_SCORING_METHOD.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_SCORE
columns.comment: The maximum score for the question. For an automatically scored question it will be calculated. For a manually scored question it will be manually assigned to this question.

columns.name: SCORE_FOR_NO_RESPONSE
columns.comment: Score that is automatically assigned to an optional question if no response is provided for the question.

columns.name: SCORING_APPROACH
columns.comment: The automatic scoring approach for multiple choice multiple select questions. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for POQ_QUESTION_SCORING_APPROACH.

columns.name: ACTIVATION_DATE
columns.comment: The date and time that the question was activated.

columns.name: QUESTION_SURVEY_FLAG
columns.comment: This flag will determine whether the question can have multiple responses for the question or a single response.

columns.name: QUESTION_USAGE_CODE
columns.comment: A code identifying whether the question is of type prerequisite, checklist or a regular one i.e., qualification. Possible values are PREREQUISITE, CHECKLIST and QUALIFICATION. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUP for ORA_POQ_ENTITY_CHECKLIST_USAGE.

columns.name: CREATION_SOURCE
columns.comment: A code identifying whether the question source is of type Manual or Generative AI. Possible values are MANUAL and GENERATIVE_AI. The system validates against the FND_LOOKUPS for ORA_POQ_QUESTION_CREATION_SOURCE.

An ABC Class can be assigned to 1 or more ABC Groups, but may be used only once in each ABC Group. . In addition to membership information, this table contains the priority number of the ABC Class in the ABC Group, and compile breakpoint specifications such as item sequence number from the compile, percent of items, and percent of value that goes into this ABC Class/ABC Group combination. . name: INV_ABC_ASSIGNMENTS
description: INV_ABC_ASSIGNMENTS holds assignments of inventory items to ABC Classes and ABC Groups. . An item can belong to 1 or more ABC Classes, but not more than once in each ABC Group. . An ABC Class can belong to 1 or more ABC Groups, but not more than once in each ABC Group. . The Assign ABC Items window allows the user to specify for a given ABC Group, the range of items to assign to every single ABC Class in the ABC Group. The range of items is indicated as an absolute sequence number or value; or as a percent of item, or value. Then, a concurrent program (INCAAA) looks at this assignment information and at the items compiled for that group, and assigns items to their corresponding classes. This information is stored in the INV_ABC_ASSIGNMENTS table. . Oracle Inventory uses this information to load the cycle count process.

name: INV_ATTR_UPDATE_HEADERS
description: This table stores the inventory attribute update requests created in Oracle Fusion Inventory. The attribute update requests update the project and task attributes associated with the on-hand inventory for an item. These requests are created based on the project transfer recommendations created in Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Planning. These requests can also be initiated when project transfer requests are created using an Inventory Attribute Transaction Requests REST resource. These requests are triggered in Supply Chain Planning when there is a need to move inventory from one project and task to another or to move common inventory to another project and task based on the changes in the sales order or forecast demand.

name: INV_ATTR_UPDATE_LINES
description: This table stores the details needed to execute the inventory attribute update requests in Oracle Fusion Inventory. Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Planning provides the REQUESTED_QUANTITY, PROJECT_ID, TASK_ID, TRANSFER_PROJECT_ID, and TRANSFER_TASK_ID. The requests are created in an Open status and processed in an Online processing mode when invoked from Supply Chain Planning. The requests can be created to process in Online, Concurrent, or Background processing modes using an Inventory Attribute Transaction Requests REST resource. Inventory determines the material to use to execute the project transfer and updates the TRANSFER_QUANTITY when the project transfer is executed. Inventory also determines the subinventory, locator, revision, lot numbers, and serial numbers based on the FIFO (First in, First Out) logic to execute the project transfer requests and populates the INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE, INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_INTERFACE, and INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_INTERFACE tables. The request moves to a Closed status when the project transfer is executed or when material to execute the project transfer isn't available.

name: INV_INTERORG_PARAMETERS
description: INV_INTERORG_PARAMETERS identifies the receiving organizations ("To" distribution organizations) linked to a particular organization ("From" distribution organizations). The TO_ORGANIZATION_ID identifies the organization that receives shipments from the organization identified by the FROM_ORGANIZATION_ID. . You must define the inter-organizational relationship here before you perform any inter-organization transfers in the transaction system. . INTRANSIT_TYPE indicates whether inter-organizational transfers between the two organizations will use direct or intransit transfer. . FOB_POINT indicates the 'Free on board' point and determines the point of transfer of liability/ownership. . Unit of measure, distance, transfer charge, and accounting information are also specified in this table.

name: INV_INTERSUB_PARAMETERS
description: INV_INTERSUB_PARAMETERS identifies the receiving subinventory ("To" distribution subinventory) linked to a particular subinventory ("From" distribution subinventory). The TO_SUBINVENTORY identifies the organization that receives shipments from the organization identified by the FROM_SUBINVENTORY. You must define the inter-subinventory relationship here before you perform any inter-subinventory transfers in the transaction system. TRANSFER_TYPE indicates whether inter-subinventory transfers between the two subinventory within the same organization will use direct or intransit transfer. RECEIPT_ROUTING indicates whether intransit a receipt routing option, standard receive this item first and then deliver without inspection, direct deliver this item directly to its location, or inspect this item firt and then deliver.

name: INV_LOCATOR_MAINT_DETAILS
description: This table is the detailed-level table that will outline the mass update/create actions taken for the Locator. So, if a locator update needs to happen for a specific attribute across multiple locators, then we will have one row denoting the action taken and the object on which the action is taken in the INV_SUBINV_MASS_MAINT_ACTION table, and it will have details of each locator. So, if 10 locators are being acted upon, then each locator being updated will have a row in this table with the corresponding detail. name: INV_LOT_UPDATE_DRAFT
description: The table inv_lot_update_draft represents the updates made to an inventory lot and submitted for approval via Electronic Records and Electronic Signature framework. When a lot is submitted for approval, a new record is inserted into this table with a unique value for electronic record identifier, the lot number being updated, and the values for all the updateable attributes. On approval, the values are copied from this table to inv_lot_numbers and the draft row is deleted. On rejection, no change is propagated to inv_lot_numbers and the draft row is deleted.

name: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS
description: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS stores a record of every material transaction or cost update performed in Inventory. . . . Records are inserted into this table either through the transaction processor or by the standard cost update program. The columns TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID, TRANSACTION_ACTION_ID, TRANSACTION_SOURCE_TYPE_ID, TRANSACTION_SOURCE_ID and TRANSACTION_SOURCE_NAME describe what the transaction is and against what entity it was performed. . . . If the item is under lot control then the lot records are stored in INV_TRANSACTION_LOT_NUMBERS, joined by the column TRANSACTION_ID. If the item is under serial control then the serial records are stored in INV_UNIT_TRANSACTIONS, joined by the column TRANSACTION_ID. The Item revision and locator control are stored in the columns REVISION and LOCATOR_ID respectively. . . . Transfer transactions are represented as two single records in the table. They are related through the column TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_ID, which contains the TRANSACTION_ID of the other transaction in the transfer. . . . . . . . . The index INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_UPGD is used only during install and upgrade, and will be dropped during the course thereof, but is included here for completeness.

name: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP
description: INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP is the gateway for all material transactions. . . . Records are processed from this table into Inventory through the transaction processor. All Inventory transaction forms write directly to this table. Outside applications must write transaction records to INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE to be processed through INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP and the transaction processor by the Transaction Worker concurrent program. . . . Lots and serial numbers for a INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP(MMTT) record are stored in the tables INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_TEMP(MTLT) and INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_TEMP(MSNT). If the item is under lot control, then MMTT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to MTLT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. If the item is also under serial number control, then MTLT.SERIAL_TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to MSNT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. If the item is only under serial number control, then MMTT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to MSNT.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. . . . Transfer transactions are stored in this table as a single record. The transaction processor creates two transactions from the single record. . .

name: INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL
description: INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL stores quantity on hand information by control level and location. . . . INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL is maintained as a stack of receipt records, which are consumed by issue transactions in FIFO order. The quantity on hand of an item at any particular control level and location can be found by summing TRANSACTION_QUANTITY for all records that match the criteria. Note that any transactions which are committed to the table INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP are considered to be played out as far as quantity on hand is concerned in Inventory transaction forms. All our Inquiry forms and ABC compile are only based on INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL. . . . INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL has two columns, CREATE_TRANSACTION_ID and UPDATE_TRANSACTION_IDs to join to INV_MATERIAL_TXNS.TRANSACTION_ID the transactions that created the row and the transaction that last updated a row. . . . . . . .

name: INV_ORG_PARAMETERS
description: INV_ORG_PARAMETERS maintains a set of default options like locator, lot, and serial controls; item sourcing etc. for each organization defined in Oracle Inventory. Each organization's item master organization (MASTER_ORGANIZATION_ID) is maintained here. You specify which manufacturing calendar the organization will use (CALENDAR_CODE), as well as the set of exceptions to this calendar (CALENDAR_EXCEPTION_SET_ID). .NEGATIVE_INV_RECEIPT_CODE indicates whether this organization will allow negative balances in inventory. It is used in the transaction system to ensure, for example, that you do not over-issue a particular item (if you have indicated that negative balances are not allowed). For lot number and serial number auto-generation, you can specify whether you want the numbers generated from defaults defined at the organization level or the item level (LOT_NUMBER_GENERATION,SERIAL_NUMBER_GENERATION). You can also specify uniqueness constraints for lot numbers (LOT_NUMBER_UNIQUENESS) and serial numbers (SERIAL_NUMBER_TYPE).

columns.comment: Models the status of the last program job to validate or modify the item grouping behavior of this organization. Permitted values are null, SUBMITTED, FAILURE, SUCCESS.

columns.name: INTERNAL_CUSTOMER_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains True or False. True: The organization represents an internal customer and is associated to an account number and customer name. False: The organization does not represent an internal customer. The default value is false.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.comment: The account number of the customer when the organization represents an internal customer.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Indicates the identifier of the selected customer when the organization represents an internal customer.

columns.name: USE_CUR_ITEM_COST_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the warehouse will default to use the current item cost in the Create Miscellaneous Transaction task. If false, the warehouse will default to not use the current item cost. The default value is false.

columns.name: SPECIAL_HNDLNG_OVRPK_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: Y or N. If Y, then the warehouse supports overpicking and staging to accommodate material movements requiring special handling. If N, the warehouse will not support special handling. The default value is N.

columns.name: FA_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.comment: The value that uniquely identifies the fixed asset book to be associated with the assets defined in this organization.

columns.name: ALLOW_ITEM_SUBSTITUTIONS
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the default setting to allow item substitutions is yes. If false, then the default setting to allow item substitutions is no. The default value is false.

columns.name: WMS_WITH_MFG_ALM
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the plant is integrated to WMS for manufacturing or maintenance. If false, then the plant is not integrated. The default value is false.

columns.name: FILL_KILL_SALES_ORDER_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then automatically cancel the remaining quantities on sales order backorder lines during pick release, pick confirm, or ship confirm. If false, then don't cancel. The default value is false.

columns.name: KANBAN_CARD_PREFIX
columns.comment: The user supplied value to prefix each Kanban card number. The default value is the organization code followed by a dash, for example "VIND-".

columns.name: KANBAN_CARD_START_NUMBER
columns.comment: The user supplied value for the first Kanban card number. The default value is null, and indicates that Kanban is not enabled for the organization.

columns.name: KANBAN_DOC_SEQ_ID
columns.comment: Kanban card document sequence identifier. This captures the references to the FND Document Sequence.

columns.name: KANBAN_DOC_SEQ_CAT_CODE
columns.comment: Kanban card document sequence category code. This capture the reference to the FND Document Sequence Category.

columns.name: MAINT_TECH_WB_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the organization is enabled to be viewed in the maintenance technician workbench. If false, the organization is not visible in the workbench. The default value is false.

columns.name: EXPIRED_LOT_SUBINVENTORY
columns.comment: The user selected subinventory where expiring lots will be quarantined.

columns.name: EXPIRED_LOT_LOCATOR
columns.comment: The user selected locator in the subinventory where expiring lots will be quarantined.

columns.name: LOT_CONVERSION_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the lot specific conversion is created or updated for the lot when a transaction modifies the secondary quantity for a given primary quantity, which indicates a change to the existing lot conversion value. If false, then the organization isn't enabled and lots will use existing UOM conversions. The default value is false.

columns.name: AUTOCRT_LOT_UOM_CONV_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the organization is enabled automatically create lot specific conversion updates for items if transactional work modifies the secondary quantity to a value which does not use the existing lot conversion value. If false, then the user must explicitly update the existing UOM conversions for lots. The default value is false.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERISSUE_WO_PICK
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, the manufacturing user will be allowed to specify component quantities on work orders which are greater than those in the work definition. If false, the existing behavior for pick quantities will continue. The default value is false.

columns.name: REQ_BARCODE_VALIDATION
columns.comment: Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, barcode format validation is used on supplier part numbers or items without barcodes when the inventory user scans inventory transactions. If false, the barcode format isn't validated. The default value is false.

name: INV_PICK_CONFIRM_INT
description: INV_PICK_CONFIRM_INT is the gateway for pick confirm transactions through REST web service. . . . Lots and serial numbers for a INV_PICK_CONFIRM_INT(IPCI) record are stored in the tables INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_INTERFACE(ITLI) and INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_INTERFACE(ISNI). If the item is under lot control, then IPCI.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to ITLI.TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID. If the item is also under serial number control, then IPCI.SERIAL_TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to ISNI.TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID. If the item is only under serial number control, then IPCI.TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to ISNI.TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID

name: INV_PICK_SLIP_NUMBERS
description: Parallel pick release uses this table to store pick slip numbers. Pick slip number generation is based on grouping criteria specified in the pick slip grouping rule specified at the time of pick release. Every time a line is allocated with the same criteria as a previously allocated line, the same pick slip number is to be assigned. When pick release is run as a single process, pick slip number assignment is accomplished by caching pick slip numbers and the corresponding grouping criteria in memory. When multiple concurrent pick release processes run in parallel, this approach will not work since these processes do not have visibility of each others cached data structures. Hence a database table is needed to store pick slip numbers and the grouping criteria. Data in this table is deleted at the end of the pick release run.

name: INV_SECONDARY_INVENTORIES
description: INV_SECONDARY_INVENTORIES is the definition table for the subinventory. A subinventory is a section of inventory, i.e., raw material, finished goods, etc. Subinventories are assigned to items (in a many to one relationship), indicating a list of valid places where this item will physically exist in inventory. . Other attributes include general ledger accounts, demand picking order, locator type, availability type, and reservable type. . You can also specify whether this subinventory is an expense or asset subinventory (ASSET_INVENTORY), or whether quantities are tracked (QUANTITY_TRACKED). .

name: INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_TEMP
description: INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_TEMP holds temporary serial number transaction records for a parent record in INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP. Data in this table will eventually reside in INV_UNIT_TRANSACTIONS after processing by the transaction processor. TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID joins to TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID in INV_MATERIAL_TXNS_TEMP when under serial control. If also under lot control it joins to INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_TEMP.SERIAL_TRANSACTION_TEMP_ID. . . . It is possible to have child records in this table without a parent record due to the autocommit feature of the Serial Number Entry form. Periodic deletion of irrelevant data from this table is desired.

name: INV_SUPPLY
description: INV_SUPPLY stores incoming supply information for an organization. This table forms one of the sources in Inventory's Demand-Supply form. There are four different types of supply captured in this table: . 1) Approved Requisitions . 2) Approved Purchase orders . 3) Shipments from suppliers . 4) Intransit shipments from another organization . Types 3 and 4 could be distinguished by the presence of data in the INTRANSIT_OWNING_ORGANIZATION_ID column, which identifies the ownership of the items in intransit. If this column is null then it means that the shipment supply is from a Vendor. . This information is used by the available to promise routine to derive the ATP information as appropiate. Quantities of items in intransit are also kept track of in the table. . Records in INV_SUPPLY are created every time you approve a requisition or a PO or create an intransit shipment. One record of REQ type will be created for one requisition line when the requisition is approved. One record of PO type will be created per PO distribution when a PO is approved and one record per shipment line will be created when a shipment is created. . Records in INV_SUPPLY will be recreated whenever there are transactions such as return to receiving, return to vendor or cancellation of purchase orders. . Records in INV_SUPPLY are deleted every time you change the document status to not approved. For example, a PO would require approval if you change the line and shipment quantity. If such a PO is re-approved then the PO supply will be recreated for the new quantity. . The supply type code of a REQ supply record is changed to PO every time a requisition is autocreated. Similarly the supply type code is changed from PO to RECEIVING when a PO is fully received. If a PO is partially received then a supply with the supply type code of RECEIVING will be created for the quantity received. When the receipt is delivered the RECEIVING supply is deleted. SHIPMENT supply works in the same way as PO supply. . There is a database trigger on INV_SUPPLY with the name INV_SUPPLY_T. This trigger fires on insert, update or deletion of records in INV_SUPPLY. It inserts records into MRP_RELIEF_INTERFACE table.

name: INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE
description: INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE allows calling applications to post material transactions (movements, issues, receipts etc. to Oracle Inventory transaction module. Transaction Manager concurrent program polls this table at a user-specified process interval, and submits the Transaction Workers to process them. Processing consists of data derivation, validation, and the transfer of records from INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE, INV_TRANSACTION_LOTS_INTERFACE, and INV_SERIAL_NUMBERS_INTERFACE into their respective temporary tables, from where they are processed by the transaction processor. INV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE follows the Inventory standard for interfacing flexfields. Any parameters which are represented by flexfields may be entered in the interface table either as code combination identifiers or as flexfield segment combinations. The Transaction Worker will validate that any given identifiers are valid and enabled. If no identifier is given, then the Transaction Worker will validate and decode the flexfield segment values, and where appropriate, create new flexfield combinations in the database. The Transaction Manager picks up the rows to process based on the LOCK_FLAG, TRANSACTION_MODE, PROCESS_FLAG. Only records with TRANSACTION_MODE of '3', LOCK_FLAG of '2', and PROCESS_FLAG of '1' will be picked up by the Transaction Manager and assigned to a Transaction Worker. If a record fails to process completely, then PROCESS_FLAG will be set to '3' and ERROR_CODE and ERROR_EXPLANATION will be populated with the cause for the error. Scope: public Lifecycle: active Display Name: Material Transactions Interface Product: INV Category: BUSINESS_ENTITY INV_MATERIAL_TRANSACTION

columns.comment: Primary key of the transaction reason.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

name: INV_TRANSFER_ORDERS_INT
description: A transfer orders serves as the orchestration document representing demand and supply for an internal material transfer. name: INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES_TL
description: INV_TXN_SOURCE_TYPES contains information about valid transaction source type in the system. There are two kinds of transaction source types. System transaction source types are those seeded when the system is installed, bear source type identifiers of 1 through 13 and use system validation. User defined transaction source types have have identifiers higher than 100, and may have validation set up through the use of the descriptive flex context in the 'Transaction Source' descriptive flexfield. . Transaction source types are used in defining user transaction types, which would in turn be used in different inventory transactions. .

columns.comment: Reason that describes why an item was substituted on a fulfillment line.

columns.name: REQUESTED_SHIP_DATE
columns.comment: Original date the customer requested the item to ship.

columns.name: REQUESTED_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comment: Original date the customer requested the to item arrive.

columns.name: PACKING_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.comment: A message that provides information concerning the packing of an item.

columns.name: SHIPPING_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.comment: A message that provides details about cargo and any requirements for its physical movement.

columns.name: TXN_BUSINESS_CATEGORY_NAME

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAXATION_COUNTRY

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAX_COUNTRY_SHORT_NAME
columns.comment: Short name of the country used for tax calculation purposes.

columns.comment: Unique identifier of the registration number that is quoted to the supplier. Supplier uses this number to tax the transaction.

columns.name: FIRST_PARTY_TAX_REG_NUMBER
columns.comment: Registration number that is quoted to the supplier. Supplier uses this number to tax the transaction.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_TAX_REG_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier of the customer registration number that is specified by the customer on the purchase order.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_TAX_REG_NUMBER
columns.comment: Customer registration number specified by the customer in the purchase order.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE
columns.comment: Classification that is used for tax calculation and tax reporting, depending upon the requirements of different countries.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE_NAME
columns.comment: Name of Document Sub Type used for tax calculation and tax reporting depending upon the requirements of different countries.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.comment: Invoice number used for tax reporting.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.comment: Invoice date used for tax reporting.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CATEGORY_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier of the classification of the products by tax authority for tax purposes.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.comment: Classification name of the product by tax authority for tax purposes.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comment: Product-related classification in Oracle Fusion Tax. The value of the product type specifies whether the transaction line is for a good or service, or whether it is a memo line.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME
columns.comment: A product related classification in Oracle Fusion Tax that specifies whether the transaction line is for a good, or a service, or it is a memo line.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.comment: Product classification for tax purposes.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.comment: A classification of products for tax purposes.

columns.name: TAX_ASSESSED_PRICE
columns.comment: Price at which a product is valued by a tax authority for a given tax.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS
columns.comment: Classification of the transaction into different categories for tax purposes.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISC_CLASS_NAME
columns.comment: Name of another classification of the transaction into different categories for tax purposes.

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_CLASSIFICATION_ID

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_CLASS_NAME
columns.comment: The classification for intended use for tax calculation purposes.

columns.name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_LEVEL_CODE

columns.name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_LEVEL
columns.comment: Level of service to be used for delivery of the shipment.

columns.name: SHIPPING_MODE_CODE
columns.comment: Code that represents the type of transportation used to ship the product, such as truck, air, or boat.

columns.name: SHIPPING_MODE
columns.comment: Shipping mode that was actually used to deliver the goods.

columns.name: SHIPPING_CARRIER_CODE
columns.comment: Code that represents the shipping carrier that delivered the goods.

columns.name: SHIPPING_CARRIER
columns.comment: Shipping carrier that delivered the goods.

columns.name: EARLIEST_ACCEPTABLE_SHIP_DATE
columns.comment: Earliest date that the customer is willing to receive a shipment.

columns.name: LATEST_ACCEPTABLE_SHIP_DATE
columns.comment: Latest date that the customer is willing to have a warehouse ship a product.

columns.name: LATEST_ACCEPTABLE_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comment: Latest date that the customer is willing to receive a product.

columns.name: PROMISED_SHIP_DATE
columns.comment: Date that was promised to the customer that the item would ship.

columns.name: PROMISED_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comment: Date that was promised to the customer that the item would arrive.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_CERTIFICATE_NO
columns.comment: Tax exemption certificate number.

columns.name: REQUIRED_FULFILLMENT_DATE
columns.comment: Customer required fulfillment date.

columns.name: ACTUAL_SHIPPED_DATE
columns.comment: The date the shipment was actually sent.

columns.name: FULFILLMENT_DATE
columns.comment: Date when the fulfillment task is completed.

columns.name: RMA_DELIVERED_QUANTITY
columns.comment: The quantity delivered against the receipt line.

columns.name: SHIPPED_QUANTITY
columns.comment: Quantity of product on an order line that is shipped.

columns.name: RESERVED_QUANTITY
columns.comment: Quantity of an item that was set aside in a warehouse specifically to fulfill the demand from a given fulfillment line.

columns.name: INVENTORY_RESERVATION_ID
columns.comment: Reference to the unique identifier for the inventory reservation.

columns.name: REQUEST_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates if the scheduling request is of type SHIP or ARRIVAL.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.comment: The date when fulfillment line is processed completely.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_FULFILLMENT_COST

columns.name: ESTIMATED_MARGIN_AMOUNT
columns.comment: The estimated margin expected when shipping the fulfillment line.

columns.name: CONFIG_ITEM_REFERENCE
columns.comment: Reference to the identifier of the finished ATO item in an ERP system where the fulfillment of the finished item is done by that ERP system.

columns.name: BUYER_NAME

columns.name: PURCHASING_UOM

columns.comment: The latest date that the customer is willing to receive a product.

columns.name: EARLIEST_ACCEPT_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.comment: The earliest date that the customer is willing to receive a product.

columns.name: REFERENCE_HEADER_ID

columns.name: FREEZE_PRICE_FLAG

columns.comment: Fusion value for the Priority of transportation that affects how quickly goods are transported

columns.name: FOB_POINT_CODE_F

columns.name: HEADER_UPDATE_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains Y or N. Y: you can use redesigned pages in the Order Management work area to update the order header. N: you can't do this update. A processing constraint controls whether you can do an Update operation on the sales order entity, and it determines this attribute's value each time you revise the order. This attribute doesn't apply when you import an order.

columns.name: LINE_ADD_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains Y or N. Y: you can use redesigned pages in the Order Management work area to add an order line to a sales order. N: you can't do this add. A processing constraint controls whether you can do a Create operation on the sales order entity, and it determines this attribute's value each time you revise the order. This attribute doesn't apply when you import an order.

columns.name: REVISION_REASON_CODE
columns.comment: Abbreviation that identifies the reason why the user revised the sales order.

columns.name: REVISION_COMMENTS
columns.comment: Comments that the user can enter on the order header when revising the sales order.

columns.name: REDWOOD_ELIGIBLE_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains Y or N. Y: Order Management hasn't migrated this sales order to Redwood. N: Order Management already migrated it. Use this attribute when you don't create the sales order in Redwood and need to migrate it to Redwood. For example, you create it in the ADF UI, REST API, or SOAP, and then must migrate it to Redwood. This attribute is for Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: ASSESSED_IN_REL_FOR_REDWOOD
columns.comment: Identifies a release. This is an internal column that Oracle uses to record the last eligibility release check for a sales order. This value is reset at the beginning of each release for reassessment of sales orders that have not been migrated in prior releases.

columns.name: AUTO_SAVED_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates whether the order was automatically saved. This column is applicable only to the New Sales Order page.

columns.name: PRICING_DATE
columns.comment: Date that you want pricing to use when it prices a sales order or order line. Pricing will use the prices that are in effect as of that date.

columns.name: RETURN_COMMENTS
columns.comment: Comments captured or generated to determine the reason for the customer's product return.

columns.name: ORDER_REP_USERNAME
columns.comment: Name of the user who represents the sales order.

columns.name: BILLING_SET_FLAG
columns.comment: Contains Y or N. Y: Group the order lines into a single invoice. N: don't.

columns.name: AGENT_CODE
columns.comment: Code of the AI agent that created this order.

name: DOO_ORDER_INCENTIVES
description: Table stores sales incentive information on Order Header or Line. A sales incentive encourages a specific buying behavior by either offering a special pricing, rebates, on invoice or off invoice discounts, accruals by either an contractual agreement or by marketing offers or by sales channel programs. Sales Incentives can be of various types like Channel Programs, Marketing Promotion or Sales Agreement. For example, 10% rebate accrued on product X sourced from supplier S. 10% discount on product Y this month if ordered quantity crosses 15000 units for the month. 10% Contractual Discount for all category A products this quarter.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comment: Adjustment numeric value associated with the Adjustment Type.

columns.comment: Relevant when price type is Recurring. Mutually exclusive with Usage UOM. E.g. Possible values are Monthly (MONTHLY), Weekly (WEEKLY), yearly (YEARLY), etc.

columns.comment: Flag to indicate if additional pricing discounts can be applied to a charge on a line associated to this pricing term. Allowed values are 'Y' and 'N' and null will be treated as 'Y'.

columns.comment: Indicates if the Adjustment is applicable to the coverage item alone or the rollup (applicable when item on term is a a coverage item). Based on lookup type YES_NO.

columns.comment: Value that uniquely identifies the pricing term. For discount list, it is the source ID of either simple rule, tiered rule or attribute rule.

columns.comment: Name of the pricing term. For discount list, it is the name of either simple rule, tiered rule or attribute rule.

columns.comment: Abbreviation that indicates the type of the discount rule such as simple, tiered, attribute rule. The value as based on lookup type ORA_QP_PRICING_RULE_TYPES.

columns.comment: Abbreviation that indicates if the price types such as one time, recurring, etc. The values are based on the lookup type ORA_QP_PRICE_TYPES.

columns.comment: Abbreviation that indicates the charge type of the Pricing term. The values are based on the lookup type. Not applicable for benefit types Price List and Accrual. The values are based on the lookup type ORA_QP_CHARGE_TYPES.

columns.comment: Effective End Date of this record. It is optional attribute.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE

columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BENEFIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comment: Denormalized from the parent. Mandatory for Pricing Term. When called from Price List Line,then the Benefit Type=Price Adjustment.When called from shipping line,then the Benefit Type will be Ship Adjustment,when called from Pricing Term,then the Benefit Type will be Accrual.

columns.name: BENEFIT_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.comment: Denormalized from the parent.When Benefit Type is Shipping Adjustment, Subtype may be one of Duty,Freight Handling or Insurance. Based on Lookup_type : QP_SHIPPING_CHARGE_TYPE

columns.name: ITEM_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comment: Denormalized from Parent entity. The values are PRODUCT GROUP , ITEM CATEGORY or ITEM

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.comment: Denormalized from parent Entity. This will be used to generate Tiered Pricing Name.

columns.name: PRICING_UOM_CODE
columns.comment: Denormalized from the parent entity. Line UOM code.

columns.name: LEVEL_CODE
columns.comment: Denormalized from the parent entity. Indicates Header or Line level.Price List will pass in LINE.Pricing term will pass in LINE/HEADER

columns.name: AGGREGATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.comment: Accumulation will evaluate the volume for Tiers. When LEVEL is LINE, values include On Line,On Document,Over Time Duration of Agreement,Over Time Specific Duration,or Over Time Recurring Interval,when LEVEL is ORDER Values include On Document,Over Time Duration of Agreement,Over Time Specific Duration or Over Time Recurring Interval. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_AGGREGATION_METHOD_CODE .

columns.name: TIER_BASIS_TYPE_CODE
columns.comment: It is the Volume Attribute of the Transaction for tier evaluation. This value will be used in the PDP for conditional steps in the Tiered Pricing Step. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_TIER_BASIS.

columns.name: TIER_BASIS_ID
columns.comment: This points to the Pricing_Basis_Id in QP_PRICING_BASIS_VL where usage = Tier Basis or Accumulation Basis. Indicates across what charge or set of charges the tier basis will be evaluated against when the Tier Basis Type is Amount. Indicates across what charge or set of charges the basis will be used for accumulating the values across orders.

columns.name: GRADUATED_CODE
columns.comment: Graduated Flag Checked -> Graduated - Range Pricing , Unchecked - Simple Tiered Pricing

columns.name: APPLICATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.comment: Applicable when Tier Basis Type is Product Quantity Application Method Code - Values are Per Unit , Per Block This determines how the pricing is calculated. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_APPLICATION_METHOD_CODE

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.comment: Orders to be taken for Tier evaluation based on Peroid From Date Type Code. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_PERIOD_FROM_DATE_TYPE_CODE .

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM_DATE
columns.comment: Period From Date is either Start Date or Pricing Date depending on the value of the Period_Date_Type_Code

columns.name: AGGREGATION_DURATION
columns.comment: The number of units indicates the duration for the tier evaluation.

columns.name: AGGR_DURATION_UOM_CODE
columns.comment: This indicates the duration unit - for example Day , Month or Year. The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_DURATION_UOM_CODE .

columns.name: INCL_VALUE_ON_CURR_DOC_FLAG
columns.comment: Applicable when aggregation method is Over time options.If checked -> To include the current order amount or quantity in the PDP

columns.name: EXPLANATION_MESSAGE_ID
columns.comment: WATERFALL_MESSAGE_NAME for the Waterfall to indicate if Tiered Pricing apply to Lines. This Points to PRICING_MESSAGE_ID in QP_PRICING_MESSAGES_B

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates the type of Adjustment that is applied to the selling price- The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE .

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ID
columns.comment: This points to the Pricing_Basis_Id in QP_PRICING_BASIS_VL where usage = Adjustment Basis If the value is entered, the value will be defaulted to the Adjustment Basis in Tiered Pricing Lines. This is only applicable when adjustment type is percent based adjustment.

columns.name: PARTIAL_BLOCK_ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Applicable when Application Method is PER BLOCK.It indicates which block to be considered if increment value is entered.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_PERIOD_CODE
columns.comment: This indicates the accumulation period . For example Daily , Weekly, etc .The LOOKUP_TYPE IS : QP_AGGREGATION_INTERVAL_CODE

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comment: This indicates the currency when the adjustment type code is Price Override/markup amount/discount amount.

columns.name: ENFORCE_ADJ_CALCULATION_FLAG
columns.comment: This flag controls whether certain attributes on the TP line are editable or not.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates the accrual currency when Benefit Type is Accrual and Adjustment Type is Fix Amount. This is based on Lookup_Type : QP_ACCRUAL_CURRENCIES.

columns.name: TIER_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.comment: This attribute will include the following values passed from the parent entity: Item,Coverage,Accrual. The value of this attribute will be used to determine the list of values to be displayed for the adjustment type.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.comment: Currency conversion rate as returned by the GL conversion API.

columns.name: UOM_CONVERSION_FACTOR
columns.comment: Conversion factor from source document UOM to primary UOM of the receipt transaction. This is computed using the quantities present on the receive transaction.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Status of currency and uom conversion. Possible values: ERROR - failure in currency conversion SUCCESS - all conversions are updated and the line is ready for further processing.

description: The table RCV_RECEIPT_DELIVERIES stores all the information about the deliveries in receiving. There are two categories of deliveries - ad hoc and receipt-based. Ad hoc deliveries are manually created, and are not usually associated to a document like a purchase order or a transfer order. Receipt-based deliveries are created automatically on creating a receiving receipt, and are assigned to an employee or a contingent worker by a warehouse manager. The assignee will deliver the package to the eventual recipient, who confirms delivery through a signature or some other method.

name: RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS
description: RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS stores common information about the source of your receipts or expected receipts. You group your receipts by the source type and the source of the receipt. Oracle Purchasing does not allow you to group receipts from different sources under one receipt header. . There are two receipt source types, Supplier and Internal Order, that you need to use when receiving against different source document types. You use a receipt source type of 'Supplier' when receiving items that you ordered from an external supplier using a purchase order. When you receive items that are part of an inter-organization transfer, or when receiving items that you request from your inventory using an internal requisition, the receipt type would be 'Internal Order'. The 'Internal Order' receipt source type populates the ORGANIZATION_ID column. . Oracle Purchasing creates a receipt header when you are entering your receipts or when you perform inter-organization transfers using Oracle Inventory. When Oracle Inventory creates a receipt header for an intransit shipment, the receipt number is not populated until you receive the shipment. .

name: RCV_SERIALS_SUPPLY
description: RCV_SERIALS_SUPPLY stores information about the serial numbers that are currently available to transact for intransit shipments. . name: RCV_TRANSACTIONS
description: RCV_TRANSACTIONS stores historical information about receiving transactions that you have performed. When you enter a receiving transaction and the receiving transaction processor processes your transaction, the transaction is recorded in this table. . Once a row has been inserted into this table, it will never be updated. When you correct a transaction, the net transaction quantity is maintained in RCV_SUPPLY. The original transaction quantity does not get updated. You can only delete rows from this table using the Purge feature of Oracle Purchasing. .

name: FOS_PRICING_DETAILS
description: The FOS_PRICING_DETAILS table stores off the accounting transfer prices, seller's assessable value and buyer's assessable value after they are calculated so that they will be readily available, rather than having to recalculate them each time a request is made for them.

columns.comment: This is the primary key and its value is an application generated unique id.

columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.comment: The source document identifier for which the unit price was calculated. For example, in procurement it would store the PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID; for distributed order orchestration it would store the FULFILLMENT_LINE_DETAIL_ID; and for internal material transfers it would store the LINE_ID.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE

columns.comment: The source of this supply Request

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SCORE
columns.comment: A score that enables you to prioritize your accounts

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SCORING_TIER
columns.comment: A grouping of accounts

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comment: Short description for the company

columns.name: KEYWORDS
columns.comment: Array of the company's top keywords

columns.name: DATAFOX_COMPANY_ID
columns.comment: Datafox Company Identifier

columns.name: PARENT_ACC_PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Parent Account Party Identifier

columns.name: PARENT_ACC_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.comment: Parent Account Public Identifier

columns.name: PARENT_ACC_PTY_SRC_SYSTEM
columns.comment: Source System of Parent Account

columns.name: PARENT_ACC_PTY_SRC_SYSTEM_REF
columns.comment: Source System Reference value for Parent Account

columns.name: SALES_PROFILE_NUMBER
columns.comment: Public Unique Identification Number for this Sales Account

columns.name: PHONE_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Status of the validation processed by the email and phone verification service or by the user. The value for this attribute should be predefined in the lookup type HZ_CP_VALIDATION_STATUS_TYPE. The values can be VALID, INVALID, and so on.

columns.name: PHONE_VERIFICATION_DATE
columns.comment: Date at which the validation of the phone was done by the email and phone verification service or by the user.

columns.name: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Status of the validation processed by the email and phone verification service or by the user. The value for this attribute should be predefined in the lookup type HZ_CP_VALIDATION_STATUS_TYPE. The values can be VALID, INVALID, and so on.

columns.name: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DATE
columns.comment: Date at which the validation of the email was done by the email and phone verification service or by the user.

columns.name: FAX_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Status of the validation processed by the email and phone verification service or by the user. The value for this attribute should be predefined in the lookup type HZ_CP_VALIDATION_STATUS_TYPE. The values can be VALID, INVALID, and so on.

columns.name: FAX_VERIFICATION_DATE
columns.comment: Date at which the validation of the fax was done by the email and phone verification service or by the user.

columns.name: GLOBAL_ULTIMATE_DATAFOX_ID
columns.comment: DataFox Company Identifier of the Global Ultimate for the account, which is the highest family member globally across countries of this business entity as you walk up this branch of the tree. A case may be its own Global Ultimate.

columns.name: DOMESTIC_ULTIMATE_DATAFOX_ID
columns.comment: DataFox Company Identifier of the Domestic Ultimate for the account,which is the highest family member in the same country as this business entity. A subject may be its own Domestic Ultimate.

name: HZ_ACCT_PRODUCT_RELS_INT
description: This table HZ_ACCT_PRODUCT_RELS_INT is used to import simplified account product relations attributes.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier of the hz_acct_product_rels_int interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comment: Status code for Import.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates action entered by user

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates the action of insert or update for internal use.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.comment: This column is required by file import to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.comment: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: ACCT_PRODUCT_REL_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for Account Product Relations.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for the organization profiles used as a foreign key to the HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES table.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unique identification number for this party

columns.name: PARTY_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.comment: Original System for the Party

columns.name: PARTY_SOURCE_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.comment: Original System Reference for the Party

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comment: This indicates business Organization identifier.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: Product or Product Group ID

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates whether it is a Product or Product Group

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates the ownership between account and a product.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comment: The code used to identify currency like USD.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comment: The corporate currency code associated with the account. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup ZCA_COMMON_CORPORATE_CURRENCY. Review and update the profile option using the Setup and Maintenance work area, Manage Trading Community Common Lookups task.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.comment: The currency conversion rate type. This attribute is used by CRM Extensibility framework.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comment: The investment amount associated with this product

columns.name: INVESTMENT_TENURE
columns.comment: The duration associated with a customer's investment in a particular product.

columns.name: ARR
columns.comment: Annual recurring revenue associated with this product.

columns.name: RENEWAL_DATE
columns.comment: Renewal Date

columns.name: USAGE_LEVEL
columns.comment: The usage level of current product.

columns.name: SALES_MOTIONS
columns.comment: The various strategic approach used to sell a product.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

name: HZ_ACCT_PROD_SUGGESTIONS
description: The HZ_ACCT_PROD_SUGGESTIONS shows account product suggestions from USM

columns.name: ACCT_PRODUCT_SUG_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for Account Product Suggestions.

columns.name: ACCT_PRODUCT_REL_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for the account product relations used as a foreign key to the HZ_ACCT_PRODUCT_RELATIONS table.

columns.name: QUADRANT_NAME
columns.comment: The name of quadrant used in the account segmentation.

columns.name: SALES_MOTION
columns.comment: The name of the strategic action used for selling a product.

columns.name: SALES_PLAY
columns.comment: The strategic approach that a sales team uses to promote a specific product.

columns.name: ACTION_NAME
columns.comment: The name of the sales action.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: The date from which the product suggestion is effective.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: The status of account product suggestion.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

name: HZ_ACCT_PRODUCT_RELATIONS
description: The HZ_ACCT_PRODUCT_RELATIONS shows account product information from USM

columns.name: ACCT_PRODUCT_REL_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for Account Product Relations.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for the organization profiles used as a foreign key to the HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES table.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates the ownership between account and product.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comment: The type of product e.g Item or Group.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: An Identifier for Product or Product Group.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for Products.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.comment: This indicates business Organization identifier.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.comment: An identifier for Product Groups.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comment: The code used to identify currency like USD.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.comment: The revenue associated with this product.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_TENURE
columns.comment: The duration associated with a customer's investment in a particular product.

columns.name: ARR
columns.comment: Annual recurring revenue

columns.name: RENEWAL_DATE
columns.comment: Renewal Date

columns.name: USAGE_LEVEL
columns.comment: The usage indicator of the current product.

columns.name: SALES_MOTIONS
columns.comment: The name of the strategic actions used for selling a product.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.comment: The corporate currency code associated with the account. A list of accepted values is defined in the lookup ZCA_COMMON_CORPORATE_CURRENCY. Review and update the profile option using the Setup and Maintenance work area, Manage Trading Community Common Lookups task.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE

name: HZ_ACCT_CONTACTS_INT
description: This table is interface table for the Account Contact relationships which will be created from the given Account and Contact parties.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier of the HZ_RELATIONSHIPS_INT interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comment: Status code for Import

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates action entered by user

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates the action of insert or update for internal use.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.comment: This column is required by file import to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.comment: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_CONTACT_ID
columns.comment: Organization Contact ID

columns.name: CONTACT_NUMBER
columns.comment: User-defined identification number for this contact

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_CODE
columns.comment: List of values for possible department codes

columns.name: DEPARTMENT
columns.comment: Free form text used to name the department

columns.name: JOB_TITLE
columns.comment: Free form text for job title

columns.name: JOB_TITLE_CODE
columns.comment: Code given to the job title

columns.name: DECISION_MAKER_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if this contact is a decision maker. Y for a decision maker, N for someone who is not the decision maker.

columns.name: REFERENCE_USE_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if this contact can be used as a reference. Y for a contact who will act as a reference, N for a contact who cannot act as a reference.

columns.name: SALES_BUYING_ROLE_CODE
columns.comment: Contact's role in the buying process. Values could be Key Decision Maker, Secondary Decision Maker, Does Not Matter, Supporting Role.

columns.name: SALES_INFLUENCE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.comment: Contact's level of influence in the buying process. Values could be None, Political Structure, and Inner Circle.

columns.name: SALES_AFFINITY_CODE
columns.comment: Contact's affinity towards the deploying organization. Values could be Favorable, Somewhat Favorable, Indifferent, Neutral, Somewhat Negative, and Negative.

columns.name: SALES_AFFINITY_COMMENTS
columns.comment: Comments describing contact's affinity towards the deploying organization.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comment: User comments

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Status of the relationship record

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE

columns.comment: Original system reference of this relationship

name: HZ_CONSUMER_PROFILES
description: The HZ_CONSUMER_PROFILES table stores personal information about a party of the 'Consumer' type. Specifically this table would store the flattened multiple addresses, phone numbers, social handles and emails for the Consumer.

columns.name: CONSUMER_PROFILE_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the consumer profile

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.comment: Consumer status flag

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.comment: TCA Who column

columns.name: PHONE1_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates the type of the initial phone like Work, Home, Mobile etc.

columns.name: PHONE1_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.comment: International country code for the initial telephone number. For example, 33 for France.

columns.name: PHONE1_AREA_CODE
columns.comment: The area code of the initial phone within a country code.

columns.name: PHONE1_NUMBER
columns.comment: The initial telephone number formatted in the local format. The number should not include area code, country code, or extension.

columns.name: PHONE1_EXTENSION
columns.comment: Additional number of the initial phone addressed after initial connection to an internal telephone system.

columns.name: PHONE1_RAW_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unformatted initial telephone number

columns.name: PHONE1_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates that the initial phone has been reviewed by the consumer and is accurate.

columns.name: PHONE2_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates the type of the secondary phone like Work, Home, Mobile etc.

columns.name: PHONE2_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.comment: International country code for the secondary telephone number. For example, 33 for France.

columns.name: PHONE2_AREA_CODE
columns.comment: The area code of the secondary phone within a country code.

columns.name: PHONE2_NUMBER
columns.comment: The secondary telephone number formatted in the local format. The number should not include area code, country code, or extension.

columns.name: PHONE2_EXTENSION
columns.comment: Additional number of the secondary phone addressed after initial connection to an internal telephone system.

columns.name: PHONE2_RAW_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unformatted secondary telephone number

columns.name: PHONE2_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates that the secondary phone has been reviewed by the consumer and is accurate.

columns.name: PHONE3_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates the type of the tertiary phone like Work, Home, Mobile etc.

columns.name: PHONE3_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.comment: International country code for the tertiary telephone number. For example, 33 for France.

columns.name: PHONE3_AREA_CODE
columns.comment: The area code of the tertiary phone within a country code.

columns.name: PHONE3_NUMBER
columns.comment: The tertiary telephone number formatted in the local format. The number should not include area code, country code, or extension.

columns.name: PHONE3_EXTENSION
columns.comment: Additional number of the tertiary phone addressed after initial connection to an internal telephone system.

columns.name: PHONE3_RAW_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unformatted tertiary telephone number

columns.name: PHONE3_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates that the tertiary phone has been reviewed by the consumer and is accurate.

columns.name: EMAIL1_TYPE
columns.comment: Contact point type of the initial E-mail, such as business or personal. Uses the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: EMAIL1_ADDRESS
columns.comment: E-mail address of the initial E-mail.

columns.name: EMAIL1_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates that the initial E-mail has been reviewed by the consumer and is accurate.

columns.name: EMAIL2_TYPE
columns.comment: Contact point type of the secondary E-mail, such as business or personal. Uses the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: EMAIL2_ADDRESS
columns.comment: E-mail address of the secondary E-mail.

columns.name: EMAIL2_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates that the secondary E-mail has been reviewed by the consumer and is accurate.

columns.name: SOCIAL_HANDLE1_TYPE
columns.comment: Instant messaging type of the initial social handle such as Yahoo, Facebook, Twitter, MSN or ICQ

columns.name: SOCIAL_HANDLE1
columns.comment: Instant messaging ID of the initial social handle

columns.name: SHANDLE1_VERIFICATION_STATUS

name: HZ_CONTACT_POINTS
description: Electronic methods of communication with parties The HZ_CONTACT_POINTS table stores information about how to communicate to parties or party sites using electronic media or methods such as Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), e-mail, telephone, telex, and the Internet. For example, telephone-related data can include the type of telephone line, a touch tone indicator, a country code, the area code, the telephone number, and an extension number to a specific handset. NOTE: Each media or method should be stored as a separate record in this table. For example, the attributes of a complete telephone connection should be stored in a record, while EDI information should be stored in a different record. The primary key for this table is CONTACT_POINT_ID.

name: HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS
description: The HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS table stores information about customer accounts , or business relationships that the deploying company establishes with a party of type Organization or Person. This table focuses on business relationships and how transactions are conducted in the relationship. Since a party can have multiple customer accounts, this table might contain several records for a single party. For example, an individual person can establish a personal account, family account, and a professional account for a consulting practice.

name: HZ_CONTACT_PREFERENCES
description: The HZ_CONTACT_PREFERENCES table stores information about contact preferences for parties or their addresses and contact points. For example, contact preference information can capture whether the deploying company can call a party, and whether it can call a particular phone number or send e-mail to a particular address. Contact preferences can also indicate certain times of the day when a party should not be called. Additionally, preferences can be defined as valid only for a specific period of the year. Contact preference information is captured under different entities, for example HZ_PARTIES, HZ_PARTY_SITES, and HZ_CONTACT_POINTS, and also under different contact types such as calls, e-mails, visits, and so on. A preference is always set for a particular purpose or topic, for example marketing and emergency.

columns.name: CONTACT_PREFERENCE_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the contact preference

columns.name: CONTACT_LEVEL_TABLE
columns.comment: Table that stores the contact level of the contact preference. Uses the SUBJECT_TABLE lookup. Value can be HZ_PARTIES, HZ_PARTIES_SITES, or HZ_CONTACT_POINTS.

columns.name: CONTACT_LEVEL_TABLE_ID
columns.comment: Foreign key to the table specified in CONTACT_LEVEL_TABLE column. Can be PARTY_ID from HZ_PARTIES table, CONTACT_POINT_ID from HZ_CONTACT_POINTS table, or PARTY_SITE_ID from HZ_PARTY_SITES table

columns.name: CONTACT_TYPE
columns.comment: Type of contact that should or should not be made with the party. Uses the CONTACT_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_CODE
columns.comment: Permission to use or not to use a particular contact method. Uses the PREFERENCE_CODE lookup.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE
columns.comment: Appropriate subjects to send or not to send to the party that the preference is created for. Uses the PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE_ID
columns.comment: Reduced LOV depending on the preference topic table selected. The PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE_ID column and PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE_CODE column are mutually exclusive.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE_CODE
columns.comment: Reduced LOV depending on the preference topic table selected. The PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE_ID column and PREFERENCE_TOPIC_TYPE_CODE column are mutually exclusive.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_START_DATE
columns.comment: Starting date of the period during which a party should or should not be contacted.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_END_DATE
columns.comment: Ending date of the period during which a party should or should not be contacted.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_START_TIME_HR
columns.comment: Starting hour of the time range during which a party should or should not be contacted. 0-23 hour format.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_END_TIME_HR
columns.comment: Ending hour of the time range during which a party should or should not be contacted. 0-23 hour format.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_START_TIME_MI
columns.comment: Starting minute of the time range during which a party should or should not be contacted. 0-59 minute format.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_END_TIME_MI
columns.comment: Ending minute of the time range during which a party should or should not be contacted. 0-59 minute format.

columns.name: MAX_NO_OF_INTERACTIONS
columns.comment: The number of times you can use this contact point. The period of time that this number applies is stored in the MAX_NO_OF_INTERACT_UOM_CODE column.

columns.name: MAX_NO_OF_INTERACT_UOM_CODE
columns.comment: The period of time during which the maximum number of interactions applies. Uses the MAX_NO_OF_INTERACT_UOM_CODE lookup.

columns.name: REQUESTED_BY
columns.comment: Indicates if the permission or restriction was created internally or requested by the party. Uses the REQUESTED_BY lookup. Value can be Internal or Party.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.comment: Reason that this type of contact should or should not be made. Uses the REASON_CODE lookup.
