name: HZ_FINANCIAL_REPORTS
description: The HZ_FINANCIAL_REPORTS table stores information about the reports on the financial status of a party. This table does not contain numerical financial data. Detailed numerical data is available in the HZ_FINANCIAL_NUMBERS table. For example, the records in this table can indicate whether the numerical data in the HZ_FINANCIAL_NUMBERS table are actual, estimated, consolidated, and so on.

columns.name: FINANCIAL_REPORT_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier for a Financial report. Primary Key for the HZ_FINANCIAL_REPORTS table.

columns.name: DATE_REPORT_ISSUED
columns.comment: The publication date of a financial report.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_REFERENCE
columns.comment: Any specific reference name or number. For example, a library identifier or publisher's identifier (ISBN) that uniquely identifies the document or publication.

columns.name: ISSUED_PERIOD
columns.comment: The period covered by the financial report. For example, fiscal year 1999, 1Q98, and so on.

columns.name: REQUIRING_AUTHORITY
columns.comment: Name of the primary organization that requires this financial report. For example, auditors, the Federal Trade Commission, and the Internal Revenue Service.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_FINANCIAL_REPORT
columns.comment: A name for the financial report. For example, 10K report, Annual Report, Shareholder's Special Report.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WH_UDPATE_ID
columns.comment: Date when the record was entered or changed in a data warehouse

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Party identifier. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table

columns.name: REPORT_START_DATE
columns.comment: May use report start and end dates instead of ISSUED_PERIOD.

columns.name: REPORT_END_DATE
columns.comment: May use report start and end dates instead of ISSUED_PERIOD.

columns.name: AUDIT_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports are audited. Y for audited, N for unaudited.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports are consolidated. C for consolidated, N for unconsolidated.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports provide estimated data. Y for estimated, N for actual or measured data.

columns.name: FISCAL_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports cover a fiscal twelve-month accounting period. Y for a twelve-month fiscal period, N for anything other than a twelve-month fiscal period.

columns.name: FINAL_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports are the final closing statements for a business that has ceased operations. Y for final closing statements, N for normal operations.

columns.name: FORECAST_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports display forecasts or future projections. Y for forecast data, N for historical data.

columns.name: OPENING_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports are the opening statements for a business. Y for opening statements, N for normal operations.

columns.name: PROFORMA_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports are pro forma numbers. Y for pro forma numbers, N for normal numbers.

columns.name: QUALIFIED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports include qualifying remarks from auditors about the fairness and accuracy of the numbers. Y for reports qualified by auditors, N for reports that were not qualified.

columns.name: RESTATED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports include data that was corrected after the original financial reports. Y for restated, N for the original numbers.

columns.name: SIGNED_BY_PRINCIPALS_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports were signed by the principals of the organization. Y for signed reports, N for unsigned reports.

columns.name: TRIAL_BALANCE_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports include trial balance numbers. Y for trial balance numbers, N for normal numbers.

columns.name: UNBALANCED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports include balance sheet accounts that do not balance. Y for reports that include unbalanced balance sheet accounts. N for reports that only include balanced accounts.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.comment: TCA Who column

columns.name: ACTUAL_CONTENT_SOURCE
columns.comment: Additional Content Source Type column for backward compatibility.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

name: HZ_HIERARCHIES_INT
description: The interface table HZ_HIERARCHIES_INT stores information for trees and load into FND_TREE, FND_TREE_TL, FND_TREE_VERSION and FND_TREE_VERSION_TL tables.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier of the HZ_HIERARCHIES_INT interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.comment: Status code for Import

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates action entered by user

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates the action of insert or update for internal use.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.comment: This column is required by file import to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.comment: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unique identification number for this party

columns.name: LANG_CODE
columns.comment: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.comment: The purpose of this flag is to identify the row that will be responsible to perform update/insert on the _B table in the fusion schema. If the value is 'Y', the row will be used to Perform insert/update in _B table.Create rows in _TL table for languages that are enabled in fusion but have no data in the interface table.

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for a tree structure.

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.comment: User defined Identifier for tree code.

columns.name: TREE_NAME
columns.comment: The name of tree

columns.name: ICON_NAME
columns.comment: The name of the icon for the tree

columns.name: TREE_DESCRIPTION
columns.comment: The description of tree

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for the tree version and this column is for internal use only

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_NAME
columns.comment: The name of the tree version

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_DESC
columns.comment: The description of the tree version

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_COMMENT
columns.comment: The comment for the tree version

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for the data source and this column is for internal use only

columns.name: ROW_FLATTENED_TABLE
columns.comment: Specify the table name where store the data for the row flattening.

columns.name: ID_COL_FLATTENED_TABLE
columns.comment: Specify the table name where store the data for the column flattening.

columns.name: TREE_LABEL_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for the tree Label and this column is for internal use only

columns.name: PARTNER_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.comment: Original System ID for the Partner.

columns.name: PARTNER_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.comment: Original System Reference for the Partner.

columns.name: PARTNER_PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Unique Identifier for the partner party.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ACTION_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates insert, update action for tree version decided by the matching process.

columns.name: AS_OF_DATE
columns.comment: The date to use for fetch tree version when update

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comment: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comment: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

name: HZ_GROUP_PROFILES
description: HZ_GROUP_PROFILES table stores the additional information about a party of the Group type. For example, for a Household group type, it can store the household size, the average age of the Household etc.

columns.name: GROUP_PROFILE_ID
columns.comment: unique identifier for a group profile. Primary Key for the HZ_GROUP_PROFILES

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Identifier for the party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table. Part of Primary Key with EFFECTIVE_START_DATE and EFFECTIVE_END_DATE.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unique identification number for this party. Data stored in this attribute comes from PARTY_NUMBER in HZ_PARTIES.

columns.name: CERTIFICATION_LEVEL

columns.name: ESTIMATED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the financial reports provide estimated data. Y for estimated, N for actual or measured data.

columns.name: FINAL_IND

columns.name: PROFORMA_IND

columns.name: QUALIFIED_IND

columns.name: RESTATED_IND

columns.name: SIGNED_BY_PRINCIPALS_IND

columns.name: TRIAL_BALANCE_IND

columns.name: UNBALANCED_IND

columns.name: LINE_OF_BUSINESS

columns.name: LOCAL_BUS_IDEN_TYPE

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE

columns.name: SMALL_BUS_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if this company is considered to be a small business. Y for small businesses, N for all other firms.

columns.name: TOTAL_EMP_MIN_IND
columns.comment: Lookup that indicates whether the number is a minimum, maximum, or average number of total employees. A for minimum, B for maximum, and C for average.

columns.name: TOTAL_EMPLOYEES_IND
columns.comment: Lookup that indicates whether subsidiaries are included in the calculation of total employees A for totals without subsidiaries, B for totals with subsidiaries.

columns.name: TOTAL_EMPLOYEES_TEXT
columns.comment: Total number of personnel employed if can not be mapped to numeric field.

columns.name: TOTAL_PAYMENTS
columns.comment: Total number of payment experiences

columns.name: WOMAN_OWNED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if this company is primarily owned by women. Y for a women-owned firm, N for a firm that is not primarily owned by women.

columns.name: YEAR_ESTABLISHED
columns.comment: Year that the organization began doing business

columns.name: PERSON_FIRST_NAME
columns.comment: First name of the person

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Last or surname of the person

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.comment: Used to capture the Last name prefix for a person.

columns.name: PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Used to capture the second last name for a person. In some cultures it is not uncommon to have double last name.

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.comment: Middle name of the person

columns.name: PERSON_INITIALS
columns.comment: Name initials

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.comment: Indicates the place in a family structure. For example, in "Tom Jones III", the "III".

columns.name: PERSON_PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT
columns.comment: Salutary introduction such as Mr., Herr, etc

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Previous last or surname of the person

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.comment: A professional or family title. For example, Don or The Right Honorable.

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.comment: Academic title that is part of the person's name such as Dr. Jane Smith

columns.name: DATE_OF_BIRTH
columns.comment: Date the person was born

columns.name: PLACE_OF_BIRTH
columns.comment: Where the person was born. Typically, the city and country

columns.name: DATE_OF_DEATH
columns.comment: Date the person died

columns.name: DECEASED_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates whether a person is deceased.

columns.name: DECLARED_ETHNICITY
columns.comment: The declared ethnicity of the person

columns.name: GENDER
columns.comment: The gender (male, female, unknown) of the person

columns.name: HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if the person is the head of the household. Y for the head of a household, N for people who are not the head of a household.

columns.name: HOUSEHOLD_INCOME
columns.comment: Income of the household that this person is a part of

columns.name: HOUSEHOLD_SIZE
columns.comment: The size of the household this person is a par

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.comment: Marital status of the person

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: Date when the person's marital status changed.

columns.name: PERSONAL_INCOME
columns.comment: The estimated gross annual income of the person

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comment: User comments

columns.name: GROWTH_STRATEGY_DESC
columns.comment: Growth Strategy Description.

columns.name: HOME_COUNTRY
columns.comment: Home Country of the organization if the party is an organization

columns.name: COUNTRY_REGISTERED_IN
columns.comment: Used to create tax profile and doesn't map to any TCA base tables. Tax profile is created through tax web service.

columns.name: MISSION_STATEMENT
columns.comment: Corporate charter of organization or description of a group

columns.name: PREF_FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY
columns.comment: Default currency code

columns.name: SEBL_USER_KEY_LOC
columns.comment: Location of account - optional part of User Primary Key

columns.name: STOCK_SYMBOL
columns.comment: Corporate Stock Symbol, e.g. ORCL

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.comment: Status for the data in the interface table

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.comment: Foreign Key to the Error Table

name: HZ_LOCATIONS
description: The HZ_LOCATIONS table stores information about a delivery or postal address such as building number, street address, postal code, and directions to a location. This table provides physical location information about parties (organizations and people) and customer accounts. For example, this table store a physical location such as Building 300, 500 Oracle Parkway, CA, US 94065. Records in the HZ_LOCATIONS table can store delivery and postal information about a location through columns such as the LOCATION_DIRECTIONS, POST_OFFICE and TIME_ZONE columns. One can also use the HZ_LOCATIONS table to store latitude and longitude information. Data in the HZ_LOCATIONS table is also used to determine the appropriate tax rates for sales tax and VAT calculations.

name: HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES_CX
description: The profile index table stores value change information for profile records in the history table. This information is extracted from the history table after it was updated by a batch or real-time process. Later, this information is used to find rows in the history table which contributed attribute values to the current profile record and obtain source information for each value from that row.

columns.name: RECORD_DATE
columns.comment: Last update of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.comment: Version of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE_TARGET
columns.comment: The attribute of the profile record whose value was changed. The attribute index between 0 and 999 is defined by the column order in FND column metadata for the profile table.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates if the attribute of the profile record was changed to a different value (C), initialized with a value from NULL (I), reset from a value to NULL (R) or updated with the same value (U).

name: HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES_CS
description: The profile staging table collects value change and source information for profile records being created, updated or removed based on source records received from an external system. This information is calculated by the import process after source data has been received and stored. Later, the import process uses this information to update the profile table and the history table.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: The action performed on the profile record, for example INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: PROCESS_CODE
columns.comment: The process performing an action on the profile record, for example HZ_IMPORT.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.comment: The process instance performing an action on the profile record, for example BATCH_ID for HZ_IMPORT.

columns.name: RECORD_DATE
columns.comment: Last update of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.comment: Version of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_DATE
columns.comment: Last update of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record. NULL if the source record cannot be updated.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_VERSION
columns.comment: Version of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record. NULL if the source record cannot be updated.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE
columns.comment: Indicates the profile values being changed. NULL if the value changes are undetermined, for example when updating a profile record that does not exist.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE
columns.comment: Indicates the source of the profile values being changed. NULL if the value changes are undetermined, for example when updating a profile record that does not exist.

name: HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES
description: The HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES table stores information specific to an Organization. This table gets populated or updated when a party of the type 'ORGANIZATION' is created or changed. For example: this table stores the total number of employees in a company or whether a company is minority owned. This table is also used to store historical data for the organization. Every time organization information is changed, the effective end date column for the original record is updated and a new record that contains the updated information is created.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_PROFILE_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier for organization profiles.System Generated. Primary Key

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Unique party indentifier. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.comment: Unique identification number for this party. Data stored in this attribute comes from PARTY_NUMBER in HZ_PARTIES.

columns.name: CERTIFICATION_LEVEL
columns.comment: Certification level an organization party. HZ_PARTY_CERT_LEVEL lookup type

columns.name: CERT_REASON_CODE
columns.comment: Reason for organization party''s current certification level assignment. HZ_PARTY_CERT_REASON lookup type

columns.name: PREFERRED_CONTACT_METHOD
columns.comment: How a organization prefers to be contacted. Validated against lookup HZ_PREFERRED_CONTACT_METHOD.

columns.name: PREFERRED_CONTACT_PERSON_ID
columns.comment: Person PARTY_ID of a preferred contact for a given party. There should be a valid relationship.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: SUFFIX_OVERRIDDEN_FLAG
columns.comment: This attribute will have Y if the suffix is overridden by user and N if not. Default value is N.

columns.name: UNIQUE_NAME_ALIAS
columns.comment: Name as captured by the users to internally identify the organization.

columns.name: UNIQUE_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.comment: Captures system generated or manually overridden suffix.

columns.name: DUNS_NUMBER_C
columns.comment: DUNS_NUMBER in VARCHAR format. Column value not restricted to nine digit DUNS Number.

columns.name: PARENT_DUNS_NUM_C
columns.comment: Parent is a corporation that owns more than 50% of another corporation's capital stock. The parent company can also be a subsidiary of another corporation. If the parent also has branches, then it is a headquarters as well as being a parent company. A headquarters is a business establishment that has branches or divisions reporting to it, and is financially responsible for those branches or divisi

columns.name: DOMESTIC_ULTIMATE_DUNS_NUM_C

name: HZ_ORG_CONTACTS
description: The HZ_ORG_CONTACTS table stores information about the position of the contact for a party or party site. The records in this table provide information about a contact position such as JOB_TITLE, RANK, and general contact information. This table is not used to store information about a specific person or organization, such as name and identification codes. That information is stored in the HZ_PARTIES table. For example, this table would indicate the position of an Organization Contact as an Accounts Payables Supervisor and the contact belongs to the Finance department

columns.comment: Identifier of the organization contact

columns.name: JOB_TITLE
columns.comment: Free form text for job title

columns.name: DECISION_MAKER_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if this contact is a decision maker. Y for a decision maker, N for someone who is not the decision maker.

columns.name: JOB_TITLE_CODE

columns.name: REFERENCE_USE_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if this contact can be used as a reference. Y for a contact who will act as a reference, N for a contact who cannot act as a reference.

name: HZ_ORG_CONTACT_ROLES
description: The HZ_ORG_CONTACT_ROLES table stores information about the role of the contact position that is specified in the HZ_ORG_CONTACTS table. Contacts may have multiple roles. For example, a vice president of manufacturing may have a custom-defined role as a member of a capital expenditures review board.

columns.name: ORG_CONTACT_ROLE_ID
columns.comment: Unique contact role identifier. System Generated. Primary Key.

columns.name: ORG_CONTACT_ID
columns.comment: Organization contact identifier. Foreign key to the HZ_ORG_CONTACTS table

columns.name: ROLE_TYPE

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if this is the primary role for this contact. Y for primary role, N for a non-primary role for the contact. The default value is N.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE

name: HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_TL
description: The HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_TL table provides multilingual support for source system information from the HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_B table. The HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_TL table stores translatable information for source system name and description, as well as language information.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_ID
columns.comment: Source system identifier

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_NAME
columns.comment: Source system name

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.comment: Source system description

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.comment: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.comment: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.comment: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

name: HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_B
description: The HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_B table stores information about source systems, Source systems are systems that load data into the TCA Registry. This table includes basic information about source systems, such as their name, description, and type, as well as the status of the system to indicate whether the system is actively providing data to TCA or not. The source system type can be Spoke, for legacy systems, or Purchased, for third party data providers.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_ID
columns.comment: Source system identifier

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.comment: Source system code

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_TYPE
columns.comment: Source system type, Spoke or Purchased

columns.name: SST_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if source system is enabled for Single Source of Truth and used as content source. Y for yes, N or null for no.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Status of the source system. Active or inactive.

columns.name: ENABLE_FOR_TCA_FLAG
columns.comment: Flag indicates whether a source system is enabled for use in Trading Community information or Customer Hub; Y indicates enabled for use and N indicates not enabled for use

columns.name: ENABLE_FOR_PLANNING_FLAG
columns.comment: Flag indicates whether a source system is enabled for use in Planning products; Y indicates enabled for use and N indicates not enabled for use

columns.name: ENABLE_FOR_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.comment: Flag indicates whether a source system is enabled for use in Item Master or Product Hub; Y indicates enabled for use and N indicates not enabled for use

columns.name: ENABLE_FOR_ASSET_FLAG
columns.comment: Flag indicates whether a source system is enabled for use in Assets products; Y indicates enabled for use and N indicates not enabled for use

name: HZ_ORIG_SYS_MAPPING
description: The HZ_ORIG_SYS_MAPPING table stores the mapping among source systems and owner table names. Source systems are legacy or other systems that provide data for TCA tables, or the owner tables.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.comment: Source system name

columns.name: OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.comment: TCA tables that map to the source system entities

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: A for Active. The source system can insert data into specific TCA tables.I for Inactive. The source system cannot insert data into specific TCA tables.The default is A for Active.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_FLAG
columns.comment: Y or N to indicate whether an source system reference can map to multiple OWNER_TABLE_ID columns or not..Defaults to N. This column is not used in Fusion V1.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE

name: HZ_PARTIES
description: The HZ_PARTIES table stores basic information about parties. Although a record in the HZ_PARTIES table represents a unique party, multiple parties can have the same name. The parties can be one of three types: Organization(for example, Oracle Corporation), Person(for example, Jane Doe), Group(for example, World Wide Web Consortium) Party reocrds can be created or updated using third party data sources such as Dun & Bradstreet's Global Data Products. The HZ_PARTIES table contains denormalized information from the HZ_LOCATIONS, HZ_PERSON_PROFILES, HZ_CONTACT_POINTS< HZ_ORGANIZATION_PROFILES< and HZ_PERSON_LANGUAGE tables. The identifying address contained in the HZ_PARTIES table is denormalized from the HZ_LOCATIONS table

columns.name: TOTAL_EMP_EST_IND
columns.comment: Lookup that indicates whether the employee total is estimated. A for estimated, N for not estimated or actual.

columns.name: TOTAL_EMP_MIN_IND
columns.comment: Lookup that indicates whether the number is a minimum, maximum, or average number of total employees. A for minimum, B for maximum, and C for average.

columns.name: TOTAL_EMPLOYEES_IND
columns.comment: Lookup that indicates whether subsidiaries are included in the calculation of total employees A for totals without subsidiaries, B for totals with subsidiaries.

columns.name: TOTAL_EMPLOYEES_TEXT
columns.comment: Total number of personnel employed if can not be mapped to numeric field.

columns.name: TOTAL_PAYMENTS
columns.comment: Total number of payment experiences

columns.name: WOMAN_OWNED_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if this company is primarily owned by women. Y for a women-owned firm, N for a firm that is not primarily owned by women.

columns.name: YEAR_ESTABLISHED
columns.comment: Year that the organization began doing business

columns.name: PERSON_FIRST_NAME
columns.comment: First name of the person

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Last or surname of the person

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.comment: Used to capture the Last name prefix for a person.

columns.name: PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Used to capture the second last name for a person. In some cultures it is not uncommon to have double last name.

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.comment: Middle name of the person

columns.name: PERSON_INITIALS
columns.comment: Name initials

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.comment: Indicates the place in a family structure. For example, in "Tom Jones III", the "III".

columns.name: PERSON_PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT
columns.comment: Salutary introduction such as Mr., Herr, etc

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Previous last or surname of the person

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.comment: A professional or family title. For example, Don or The Right Honorable.

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.comment: Academic title that is part of the person's name such as Dr. Jane Smith

columns.name: DATE_OF_BIRTH
columns.comment: Date the person was born

columns.name: PLACE_OF_BIRTH
columns.comment: Where the person was born. Typically, the city and country

columns.name: DATE_OF_DEATH
columns.comment: Date the person died

columns.name: DECEASED_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates whether a person is deceased.

columns.name: DECLARED_ETHNICITY
columns.comment: The declared ethnicity of the person

columns.name: GENDER
columns.comment: The gender (male, female, unknown) of the person

columns.name: HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if the person is the head of the household. Y for the head of a household, N for people who are not the head of a household.

columns.name: HOUSEHOLD_INCOME
columns.comment: Income of the household that this person is a part of

columns.name: HOUSEHOLD_SIZE
columns.comment: The size of the household this person is a par

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.comment: Marital status of the person

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: Date when the person's marital status changed.

columns.name: PERSONAL_INCOME
columns.comment: The estimated gross annual income of the person

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comment: User comments

columns.name: GROWTH_STRATEGY_DESC
columns.comment: Growth Strategy Description.

columns.name: HOME_COUNTRY
columns.comment: Home Country of the organization if the party is an organization

columns.name: COUNTRY_REGISTERED_IN
columns.comment: Used to create tax profile and doesn't map to any TCA base tables. Tax profile is created through tax web service.

columns.name: MISSION_STATEMENT
columns.comment: Corporate charter of organization or description of a group

columns.name: PREF_FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY
columns.comment: Default currency code

columns.name: SEBL_USER_KEY_LOC
columns.comment: Location of account - optional part of User Primary Key

columns.name: STOCK_SYMBOL
columns.comment: Corporate Stock Symbol, e.g. ORCL

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.comment: Status for the data in the interface table

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.comment: Foreign Key to the Error Table

columns.name: DQM_ACTION_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates record category and action to take on records being imported, based on DQM de-duplication between those records and records already in TCA. D for duplicate, P for potential duplicate, and null for new or existing record.

name: HZ_PARTY_SITES
description: The HZ_PARTY_SITES table stores all the addresses associated to a party. If the address does not exist as a location, then a new location is created and the associated between the location and party, along with the location-specific party information such as MAILSTOP and ADDRESSEE, is stored in this table. One party can have one or more party sites and alternatively, an address could be associated to multiple parties or accounts. For example, 500 Oracle Parway, Redwood City, CA can be specified as a party site for Oracle Corporation. This party site can also be used for multiple accounts created for Oracle Corporation.

name: HZ_PARTY_PREFERENCES
description: The HZ_PARTY_PREFERENCES table stores information about the preference values provided by a party. Each row defines the preference and the party's specific values for that preference. The preference is the combination of a CATEGORY and a PREFERENCE_CODE. The data type of the preference value can be a string, a number, or a date. The data type determines which VALUE column stores the party's preference value. Oracle Applications use this information to provide personalized information about a party. For example, a record could store the information that the Vision Corporation (PARTY_ID) prefers that their transaction (CATEGORY) currency (PREFERENCE_CODE) is US dollars (VARCHAR2). . The primary key for this table is PARTY_PREFERENCE_ID. . The HZ_PARTY_PREFERENCES table stores information about how a party prefers to interact with the system. Please do not attempt to use this table to store extensible attributes of a party.

columns.comment: Unique indentifier for the party's preference

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Party identifier

columns.name: MODULE
columns.comment: The program that creates the preference. For example, TCA MOBILE CUSTOMER DIRECTORY

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.comment: A preference's category can be used to logically group one or more preference codes in a particular user interface. The combination of CATEGORY and PREFERENCE_CODE identifies a preference.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_CODE
columns.comment: A preference code determines if a preference is a single value or a multiple value preference. The preference code is validated by the HZ_PREFERENCE lookup. The combination of CATEGORY and PREFERENCE_CODE identifies a preference.

columns.comment: The preference value if the data type is VARCHAR2

columns.comment: The preference value if the data type is NUMBER

columns.name: VALUE_NAME

name: HZ_PARTY_USAGE_RULES
description: Stores party usage rules.

columns.name: PARTY_USAGE_RULE_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifier for a party usage rule. Based on HZ_PARTY_USAGE_RULES_S sequence.

columns.name: PARTY_USAGE_RULE_TYPE
columns.comment: Party usage rule type. Validated against HZ_PARTY_USAGE_RULE_TYPE lookup. See table description for seeded types.

columns.name: PARTY_USAGE_CODE
columns.comment: Unique code for the party usage that the rule applies to.

columns.name: RELATED_PARTY_USAGE_CODE
columns.comment: Unique code for the related party usage. Populated when rule type is Cannot Coexist or Transition.

columns.name: DATE_FROM
columns.comment: Date from which party usage rule is effective

columns.name: DATE_TO
columns.comment: Date from which party usage rule is invalid

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.comment: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: EMAIL_FORMAT

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE

columns.name: PARTY_USAGE_CODE

columns.name: STATUS

columns.name: CLEANLINESS_SCORE

columns.name: COMPLETENESS_SCORE
columns.comment: Overall score for the contact / account record for category = Completeness.

columns.name: DATA_CONFIDENCE_SCORE

columns.comment: Signifies the duplicate status of the record determined as follows. A null value indicates that either the record is not a duplicate or it has not been evaluated. columns.name: ENRICHMENT_SCORE

columns.name: LAST_SCORE_UPDATE_DATE

columns.name: RECENCY_SCORE

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DATE

name: HZ_PERSON_LANGUAGE
description: The HZ_PERSON_LANGUAGE table stores information on the languages that a person speaks, reads or writes. For example, a person can speak both Spanish and English but can only read and write English.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_USE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.comment: Unique identifer of the language use reference

columns.name: LANGUAGE_NAME
columns.comment: The standard name for a language. For example, Spanish, Mandarin, or American English. Foreign key to the FND_LANGUAGES table.

columns.name: NATIVE_LANGUAGE_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if this language is the person's declared native language. Y for a declared native language, N for all other languages.

columns.name: PRIMARY_LANGUAGE_INDICATOR
columns.comment: Indicates if this is the primary language used by a person in day-to-day transactions. Y for the primary language, N for other languages.

columns.name: READS_LEVEL
columns.comment: User-defined level number or name to indicate the ability to read a language

columns.name: SPEAKS_LEVEL
columns.comment: User-defined level number or name to indicate the ability to speak a language

columns.name: WRITES_LEVEL
columns.comment: User-defined level number or name to indicate the ability to write in a language

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.comment: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.comment: Identifier for the party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.comment: TCA Who column

columns.name: SPOKEN_COMPREHENSION_LEVEL
columns.comment: Code to indicate comprehension of a spoken language

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: PERSON_PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT
columns.comment: Salutary introduction such as Mr., Herr, etc.

columns.comment: First name of the person

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.comment: Middle name of the person

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Last or surname of the person

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.comment: Indicates the place in a family structure. For example, in "Tom Jones III", the "III".

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.comment: A professional or family title. For example, Don or The Right Honorable.

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.comment: Academic title that is part of the person's name such as Dr. Jane Smith

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Previous last or surname of the person

columns.name: PERSON_INITIALS
columns.comment: Name initials

columns.name: JGZZ_FISCAL_CODE
columns.comment: Taxpayer identification number, often unique identifier of person or organization. Can be SSN or income taxpayer ID in US, fiscal code or NIF in Europe

columns.name: DATE_OF_BIRTH
columns.comment: Date the person was born

columns.name: PLACE_OF_BIRTH
columns.comment: Where the person was born. Typically, the city and country.

columns.name: DATE_OF_DEATH
columns.comment: Date the person died

columns.name: GENDER
columns.comment: The gender (male, female, unknown) of the person

columns.name: DECLARED_ETHNICITY
columns.comment: The declared ethnicity of the person

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.comment: Marital status of the person

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: Date when the person's marital status changed.

columns.name: PERSONAL_INCOME
columns.comment: The estimated gross annual income of the person

columns.name: HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if the person is the head of the household. Y for the head of a household, N for people who are not the head of a household.

columns.name: HOUSEHOLD_INCOME
columns.comment: Income of the household that this person is a part of

columns.name: HOUSEHOLD_SIZE
columns.comment: The size of the household this person is a part of

columns.name: RENT_OWN_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the person rents or owns his or her residence. Lookup of values for rent, own, lease, and so on.

columns.name: LAST_KNOWN_GPS
columns.comment: The geophysical location (GPS point) that was last reported for the person

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.comment: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.comment: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: INTERNAL_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates whether the person is internal or external to the user's organization. Y for a person who is a member of the user's organization, N for a person who is not a member of the user's organization.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.comment: TCA Who column

columns.name: ACTUAL_CONTENT_SOURCE
columns.comment: Additional Content Source Type column for backward compatibility.

columns.name: DECEASED_FLAG
columns.comment: Y or N indicates whether the person is deceased or not

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.comment: Used to capture the Last name prefix (e.g. 'fon', 'van', etc.) for a person. It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used. Corresponds to the field Last Name Prefix in HL7.

columns.name: PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME
columns.comment: Used to capture the second last name for a person. In some cultures it is not uncommon to have double last name. It is used in the same way the new field PERSON_SECOND_LAST_NAME in HZ_PERSON_PROFILES is used.

columns.name: PREF_FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY
columns.comment: Default Currency code for this person.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.comment: Description for a Person.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE
columns.comment: Date Effective Entity: indicates the order of different changes made during a day. The lowest value represents the earliest change in the day.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE
columns.comment: Date Effective Entity: 'Y' indicates that this row represents the latest change in the day.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

name: HZ_PERSON_PROFILES_CS
description: The profile staging table collects value change and source information for profile records being created, updated or removed based on source records received from an external system. This information is calculated by the import process after source data has been received and stored. Later, the import process uses this information to update the profile table and the history table.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.comment: The action performed on the profile record, for example INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: PROCESS_CODE
columns.comment: The process performing an action on the profile record, for example HZ_IMPORT.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.comment: The process instance performing an action on the profile record, for example BATCH_ID for HZ_IMPORT.

columns.name: RECORD_DATE
columns.comment: Last update of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.comment: Version of an existing profile record being updated or removed. NULL for a new profile record being created.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_DATE
columns.comment: Last update of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record. NULL if the source record cannot be updated.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record.

columns.name: SOURCE_RECORD_VERSION
columns.comment: Version of the source record which is used to create a new profile record or update an existing profile record. NULL if the source record cannot be updated.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE
columns.comment: Indicates the profile values being changed. NULL if the value changes are undetermined, for example when updating a profile record that does not exist.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE
columns.comment: Indicates the source of the profile values being changed. NULL if the value changes are undetermined, for example when updating a profile record that does not exist.

name: HZ_PERSON_PROFILES_CX
description: The profile index table stores value change information for profile records in the history table. This information is extracted from the history table after it was updated by a batch or real-time process. Later, this information is used to find rows in the history table which contributed attribute values to the current profile record and obtain source information for each value from that row.

columns.name: RECORD_DATE
columns.comment: Last update of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.comment: Version of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE_TARGET
columns.comment: The attribute of the profile record whose value was changed. The attribute index between 0 and 999 is defined by the column order in FND column metadata for the profile table.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE_TYPE
columns.comment: Indicates if the attribute of the profile record was changed to a different value (C), initialized with a value from NULL (I), reset from a value to NULL (R) or updated with the same value (U).

name: HZ_PERSON_PROFILES_XM
description: Custom 1:M child entity of persons. For example details of buying history.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.comment: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE

name: HZ_RELATIONSHIPS
description: The HZ_RELATIONSHIPS table stores information about relationships between two parties. The SUBJECT_ID and OBJECT_ID columns specify the two parties and the relationship_type stores the relationship. This table can also be used to specify the start and end dates of the relationship as the subject or object of a relationship can change over time. . For example, A relationship between the holding company and one of its subsidiaries would be captured in this table as two entities. Ene with the relationship type as 'Parent-of' and the holding company as a Subject and its subsidiary as the Object and the other entry would have the relationship type as 'Subsidiary-Of' and the subject is the subsidiary company and the holding company as the object. Similarly, when creating a party contact, the relationship is stored in the HZ_RELATIONSHIPS table as two entries.One with the relationship_type of 'Contact' and the party as the Subject and the contact person as the Object and the other with the relationship_type of 'Contact-Of' and the contact person as the subject and the party as the object

name: HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES
description: The HZ_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES table defines the business rules that are associated with a relationship type. A non-directional relationship type consists of a single record with the same forward (FORWARD_REL_CODE) and backward (BACKWARD_REL_CODE) relationship codes. A directional relationship type consists of two records: one for the parent (DIRECTION_CODE is P) and the other for a child (DIRECTION_CODE is C) of that parent. Forward and backward relationship codes are validated against the PARTY_RELATIONS_TYPE lookup type.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID
columns.comment: Relationship type identifier

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
columns.comment: The relationship type name. For example, CUSTOMER_SUPPLIER

columns.name: FORWARD_REL_CODE
columns.comment: The forward relationship code used to describe relationships. For example, CUSTOMER_OF

columns.name: BACKWARD_REL_CODE
columns.comment: The backward relationship code used to describe relationships. For example, SUPPLIER_OF

columns.name: DIRECTION_CODE
columns.comment: Validated by DIRECTION_CODE lookup type. P for Parent, C for Child, and N for Not Directional

columns.name: HIERARCHICAL_FLAG
columns.comment: No Longer used in Fusion V1.

columns.name: ALLOW_RELATE_TO_SELF_FLAG
columns.comment: Indicates if a party can be related to itself

columns.name: SUBJECT_TYPE
columns.comment: Subject type of the relationship type

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.comment: Object type of the relationship type

columns.name: STATUS
columns.comment: Indicates if the relationship type is inactive or active. I for Inactive, A for Active

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ALLOW_CIRCULAR_RELATIONSHIPS
columns.comment: Indicates if circular relationships are allowed using this relationship type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.comment: TCA Who column

columns.name: MULTIPLE_PARENT_ALLOWED
columns.comment: No Longer used in Fusion V1.

columns.name: ROLE
columns.comment: Unique relationship role lookup code based on relationship type and phrase. In the HZ_RELATIONSHIP_ROLE lookup type meaning is the plural role and description is the singular role.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.comment: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN

columns.name: REQUEST_ID

name: JTF_RS_ROLES_TL
description: Translation table for JTF_RS_ROLES_B. It is used to store all columns and data that are needed for Multi-Language Support.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.comment: Unique role identifier

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.comment: Role name

columns.name: ROLE_DESC
columns.comment: Role Description

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.comment: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.comment: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.comment: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.comment: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

name: JTF_RS_ROLE_RELATIONS
description: This table stores the association between resources and roles. Primary key is Resource_id and Role_id. Each resource can be assigned to multiple roles.

columns.name: ROLE_RELATE_ID
columns.comment: Role Relation identifier (PK)

columns.name: ROLE_RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.comment: Resource type. (lookup type: JTF_RS_ ROLE_RES_TYPE)

columns.name: ROLE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.comment: Resource identifier (foreign key to HZ_PARTIES) or (foreign key to JTF_RS_GROUPS_MEMBERS or (foreign key to JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS)

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.comment: Role identifier (foreign key to JTF_RS_ROLES)

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.comment: Date this role-resource becomes active

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.comment: Date this role-resource becomes inactive

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.comment: Delete Flag indicates whether this record is logically deleted or not?

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.comment: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.comment: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
